injectVar.description: Variable to inject. Can be a string or array of strings. If string, it's transformed to an array. Inferred from the prompts by default.

purpose.description: Purpose override string - describes the prompt templates

testGenerationInstructions.description: Additional instructions for test generation applied to each plugin

provider.description: Provider used for generating adversarial inputs

language.description: Language(s) of tests to generate for this plugin

frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks to include across reports and commands

entities.description: Names of people, brands, or organizations related to your LLM application

contexts.description: Security contexts for testing multiple states - each context has its own purpose

plugins.description: Plugins to use for redteam generation

strategies.description:
Strategies to use for redteam generation.

Defaults to basic, jailbreak:meta, jailbreak:composite
Supports arabic-presentation-forms, audio, authoritative-markup-injection, base64, basic, best-of-n, camelcase, citation, crescendo, custom, default, emoji, gcg, goat, hex, homoglyph, image, indirect-web-pwn, jailbreak, jailbreak-templates, jailbreak:composite, jailbreak:goblin, jailbreak:hydra, jailbreak:likert, jailbreak:meta, jailbreak:tree, layer, leetspeak, math-prompt, mischievous-user, morse, multilingual, other-encodings, piglatin, prompt-injection, retry, rot13, video

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent API calls

maxCharsPerMessage.description: Maximum number of characters allowed per generated user message

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds between plugin API calls

excludeTargetOutputFromAgenticAttackGene.description: Whether to exclude target output from the agentific attack generation process

tracing.description: Tracing defaults applied to all strategies unless overridden

graderExamples.description: Global grading examples that apply to all plugins

purpose.description: Optional purpose/context for this context - used for generation and grading, or inherited from the root redteam purpose when omitted or blank

vars.description: Variables passed to provider (e.g., context_file, user_role)

anyOf.description: Name of the plugin or path to custom plugin

numTests.description: Number of tests to generate for this plugin
